vision_ai.note: The supplied model is a two-class detector; it is not a dedicated OTR/agricultural/motorcycle/industrial classifier.

tire_car: The supplied model's car/passenger-type detection class.
tire_truck: The supplied model's truck-type detection class.
TDF: Tyre-Derived Fuel: suitable processed tyre material can be used as an alternative fuel in some industrial applications. Exact specifications and approvals are facility- and jurisdiction-specific.
TDA: Tyre-Derived Aggregate: processed tyre material used in selected civil-engineering applications such as lightweight fill and drainage-related uses. Exact specifications depend on the project and jurisdiction.
recycling: Tyre recycling can include collection, sorting, size reduction, separation of rubber, steel and textile components, and production of rubber crumb, granules, steel and TDF.
shredding: Shredding reduces whole tyres into smaller pieces for handling and further processing.
primary shredding: The first major size-reduction stage in many tyre-processing systems.
secondary shredding: Further size reduction after primary shredding for separation, granulation or product preparation.
crumb rubber: Processed recycled tyre rubber in relatively small particles used in selected roads, sports/playground surfaces and manufactured products.
granulation: Controlled size reduction that produces rubber particles for separation or product manufacture.
steel: Tyres contain reinforcing steel. Magnetic separation can recover ferrous steel for appropriate recycling streams.
fibre: Tyres contain textile/fibre reinforcement. Processing can separate fibre from rubber and steel.
OTR: Off-The-Road tyres are used on heavy equipment such as mining and construction machinery. The current model has no OTR class.
agricultural: Agricultural tyres are designed for farming machinery. The current model has no dedicated agricultural class.
motorcycle: Motorcycle tyres are designed for two-wheeled vehicles. The current model has no dedicated motorcycle class.
radial: A radial tyre uses radial-oriented carcass construction with reinforcing belts.
bias: A bias or cross-ply tyre uses diagonal carcass plies and remains common in some specialty applications.
sidewall: Sidewall markings can contain tyre size, construction, load index and speed rating. The current detector does not read sidewall markings as a dedicated OCR function.
load index: The load index is a numerical code associated with the maximum load a tyre is designed to carry under specified conditions.
speed rating: The speed rating is a tyre designation indicating the maximum speed capability under specified conditions.
passenger: Passenger tyres are intended for cars and light passenger vehicles. The supplied model maps its car detection to tire_car.
ozcom: Use approved Ozcom documentation for company-specific operational facts; this app should not invent site procedures, branch counts or acceptance rules.
tyrecycle: Use approved Tyrecycle documentation for company-specific operational facts; this app should not invent branch counts or site-specific processes.
